role_policy: Role assignments are constants shared by every condition, not experimental factors.
native_harness_policy: Each CLI may use its native agent loop. No third-party harness is an independent v1.2 factor.
substitution_policy: No aliases, fallbacks, or silent model or provider substitutions.
runtime_evidence: Every run records resolved executables, versions, arguments, configuration digests, and observed provider identity where exposed. Unobservable claims are configuration-bound only.
